title: Palette Placer
description: Client-side, allows you to create palettes with percentages that automatically selects randomly when you place
body:
![Palette Placer Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8e1a353164a78eda86e25cacd90906249c5a7c03_0.webp)

**Palette Placer** is a **client-side Fabric mod** that helps with block variation while building.

Instead of manually swapping between matching blocks, you create a weighted palette and the mod will randomly switch your selected hotbar slot to one of the configured palette blocks that is already present in your hotbar.

## Features
- Client-side only
- No server install required
- Standalone in-game palette manager
- Multiple named palettes
- Duplicate, rename, and delete palettes
- Per-block weight percentages
- Random hotbar switching based on your configured weights
- Compact HUD showing palette status and hotbar availability

## How It Works
1. Press `P` to open the palette screen.
2. Create or select a palette.
3. Add rows to the palette.
4. Hold a block in your selected hotbar slot.
5. Select a row and click **Use Held**.
6. Set the weight for each entry.
7. Put the real block stacks you want to build with in your hotbar.
8. Enable the palette.

![Palette Placer Main UI For Customization](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6aa1e6a25a18e4b6d01dba1f4c6aa3c275184947.png)

When the palette is enabled, Palette Placer automatically rerolls your selected hotbar slot between matching palette blocks in your hotbar while you build.

## Default Controls
- `P` - Open palette
- `O` - Toggle palette on/off

## HUD
The optional HUD shows:
- Active palette
- Whether the palette is enabled
- Total configured weight
- Matching blocks currently available in your hotbar

![Palette Placer Hud](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c4843e28bdc8a736ee6f2a260961c004ca1a74f7_0.webp)

## Requirements
- Fabric Loader `0.19.3+`
- Fabric API `0.151.0+26.1.2`
- Java `25`
